captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a compact speedlight camera flash, rendered in a matte black finish with realistic details. It features a rectangular lamp head with a light grey diffuser panel, mounted on a dual-axis articulation mechanism. The main vertical body houses a red front-facing sensor window, a side control panel with three rectangular buttons, and a bottom shoe mount with a locking ring. The head can tilt vertically and swivel horizontally relative to the main battery body.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated camera speedlight flash. The assembly should feature a rectangular battery body with a side control strip holding three separate push buttons, a hot-shoe mount at the bottom, and a rectangular lamp head with a front diffuser. Connect the parts using a two-axis joint system: a continuous vertical swivel joint between the body and a neck connector, and a revolute horizontal tilt joint between the neck and the lamp head.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining materials for the black casing, grey diffuser, and red sensor. It builds the base 'body' part using a Box for the main housing, a thin Box for the hot shoe, and another Box for the side control panel. Three independent 'button' parts are modeled as prismatic joints on the side. A 'neck' part is created with a Cylinder and Box, connected to the body via a continuous swivel joint. Finally, the 'head' part is modeled with a Box for the main casing, a Box for the diffuser, and side brackets, connected to the neck via a revolute tilt joint.
